propositions: The test fixture's per-event equivalence oracle calls resolve_event_commit exactly once per assertion, but the batched resolver retries up to five times, causing the oracle to return None on a transient Git error while the batched side recovers to a valid SHA.

The production resolve_event_commit deliberately returns None on any Git error, timeout, or exception and must preserve this fail-closed contract; production callers depend on None as fail-closed evidence.

The test oracle defect requires a bounded retry helper mirroring the batched-side recovery strategy, returning only non-None SHAs and raising diagnostics after exactly five attempts on persistent failure.
All batched/per-event exact equivalence assertions, including off-first-parent and ledger-parity cases, must route through the shared bounded oracle helper without weakening SHA expectations.
The repair is confined to the test fixture module; no production source changes, no changes to resolve_event_commit contract, and no changes to downstream fail-closed caller behavior.
